statement: For a 1-bounded function f : [L] → C with ∥f∥U3[L] ≥ δ, there are a degree-two filtered nilmanifold G/Γ, a polynomial sequence g : Z → G adapted to its filtration, and a function F : G/Γ → C such that 1 L L X n=1 f(n)F(g(n)Γ) ≥ ε. The dimension is at most C(1 + log(1/δ))C, and the complexity of G/Γ, the Lipschitz norm of F, and ε−1 are at most exp(C(1 + log(1/δ))C). The nilmanifold has a rational Malcev basis adapted to the filtration, with integer second-kind coordinates for Γ. The Lipschitz norm includes the supremum norm.
